name: Tokioriki
source:
Every person you choose leaves someone else behind.
After waking from an unsettling dream, high school student Kanata Tanaka begins to notice small fractures in his ordinary life.

The same classroom.

The same family.

The same friends.

The same familiar town.

Everything looks the way it always has—yet something feels wrong.

And at the center of it all is an old book.

TOKIORIKI is a psychological mystery visual novel about spending limited time, building relationships, and living with the possibilities you leave behind.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4620680/_Tokioriki/]Steam[/url]]
